description: T-4164: in what order Excel for the web applies several filters on one field. Data!A1:B6 has Product and Sales in source order Kiwi 40, Apple 50, Fig 30, Date 20, Lime 10 (total 150, no ties). Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Product, Sum of Sales: HT Apple hidden (item h) and a count top 2 filter; HP Apple hidden and a percent top 50 filter; LT1 a captionNotEqual Apple filter then a count top 2 filter (in that order in `<filters>`), multipleFieldFilters 1; TL1 the same two filters in the other order; LT0 and TL0 the same with multipleFieldFilters 0; LP1 captionNotEqual Apple then percent top 50, multipleFieldFilters 1; VT a valueLessThan 45 filter then a count top 2 filter, multipleFieldFilters 1; TV1 the VT filters in the other order; VT0 and TV0 the same two orders with multipleFieldFilters 0; PL1 LP1's filters in the other order; LP0 and PL0 the same two orders with multipleFieldFilters 0. Top-N first would keep Apple and Kiwi before Apple is removed (Kiwi alone); Apple removed first leaves Kiwi and Fig. Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
